name: realistic-document-search-benchmark
notes: Semi-real synthetic dataset for pilot search QA. It uses realistic business document patterns without real customer data.
The default benchmark mode does not download or load heavy embedding/reranking models.
OCR notes are scenario-level hints only; this file does not contain real scanned customer documents.
